title: Gate list entry
statement: Let $n,k,j\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$. Whenever $j$ is less than the length of the constructed gate list for $f$ and $k$, its entry at index $j$ is the gate assigned at index $j$ by the gate construction.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is less than the length of the gate list
